The Story

One man.
Whole band.

Doroto ACE — Amos Unogwu — is a Nigerian-born, Winnipeg-based recording artist and multi-instrumentalist. Drums first, then guitar, then keys: he builds his songs the way he builds everything else, from the ground up, until it can stand in a room and move people.

His sound sits where Afro-rock meets worship — big live energy, honest lyrics, and a single thread through every song: hope is not a mood, it’s a decision.

The Book

Death is disconnection.
Life is alignment.

In Life After Death, Doroto reframes the conversation entirely — death not as an ending, but as disconnection; life not as survival, but as alignment with the divine. A book of spiritual awakening and theological reflection, written for anyone who has ever felt far from the source.

“Not ’bout death but about life.”

Live

Built for a live room.

This is not a backing-track act. Doroto ACE is a live-band experience — the kind that turns a concert into a moment people talk about on the drive home.

Concerts & Festivals

Full-band headline and support sets, outdoor stages and theatres.

Private Events

Intimate acoustic sets for gatherings, celebrations and fundraisers.

On Location

Filmed where the land preaches first.

Doroto’s music visuals were shot in British Columbia’s Thompson Country — the Kamloops Lake viewpoint on the Trans-Canada Highway, all arid hills and wide water, and Juniper Beach Provincial Park, a desert beach on the Thompson River east of Cache Creek.

Golden hills. Open sky. No set, no backdrop — just the landscape doing what his songs do: reminding you how big hope can feel.

Watch the videos ↗
Ministry

A reason to live.

Beyond the stage, Doroto serves as Senior Pastor of Heartbeat of God (HBG) — a ministry built on a simple mission: to seek and save the lost, healing the broken and reaching the lost.

The music and the ministry are the same message in two rooms. One fills a concert hall. The other fills a life.
